title: Content equivalence iModel manifest
description: Sampling settings and local iModels used by the content equivalence tests.

$schema.description: Path or URI of the JSON schema used for editor validation.

perClass.description: Maximum number of instances sampled from each class.

seed.description: Seed used to select a deterministic sample.

imodels.description: Local iModels to compare. Names and resolved file paths must be unique.

name.description: Unique report-directory name. Starts with a letter or digit and contains only letters, digits, periods, underscores, and hyphens. Consecutive periods are not allowed.

path.description: Existing iModel file path. Relative paths are resolved from the manifest directory.

instanceKeys.description: Explicit instance keys to include in addition to the per-class sample.

className.description: Qualified EC class name, such as MySchema.MyElement or MySchema:MyElement.

id.description: Valid Id64 string with lowercase hexadecimal digits, no leading zeroes, and a nonzero local ID.
